promise: GBLIN Coherence Promise P1 — Attestation endpoint availability
subject: gblin.digital (GBLIN Protocol)
statement: The paid risk-attestation endpoint answers correctly: an unpaid GET to https://gblin.digital/api/x402/attestation returns HTTP 402 with a parseable x402 challenge, and the free sample at https://gblin.digital/api/x402/attestation-sample returns HTTP 200 with a valid attestation-shaped JSON payload.

observable.method: HTTP probe, no payment, no authentication
observable.kept_when: both checks pass in the same observation cycle

why_it_matters: A third-party agent (Markovian Protocol, ERC-8004 #59895) consumes this endpoint daily as a mandatory input of its published decision rule and records our outages in its witnessed transparency log. This promise makes the same accountability continuous and self-imposed.
notes: Pre-registered before observation began, per the GBLIN method: rules are committed before data is collected.
